content:
Hey, I took my shot at gathering all the relevant dates and deadlines for 2026 related to AI reasoning. This is a lot of content, so I expect errors, but I did my best to verify that events that really matter for me are correctly listed and they were. It would be nice to make it useful for others after putting in the work so if you'd like to use it but your conference / event is not there, let me know ;)

https://github.com/ruplet/AI-for-Math-calendar-2026/blob/main/README.md
